advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 3/4 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 1.00 / R 1.00; 3/4 stops locked both

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 31.32; 3/3 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.975 over 4 corners (4 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.70) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
